panelaPulverizada.descripcion: Panela ground to a fine, homogeneous powder, ready to dissolve immediately. Ideal for the food service sector and food industry seeking a natural and versatile sweetener.

piloncillo.descripcion: Traditional cone-shaped presentation of panela, widely recognized in Mexico and Central America. Artisanally produced, it preserves all the flavor and minerals of cane juice without refining.

panelaPartida.descripcion: Hand-broken panela blocks that preserve the texture and artisanal character of the traditional process. An authentic presentation that keeps all the natural properties of the cane intact.

panelaFraccionada.descripcion: Panela in uniform fractioned portions, designed for precise dosing in industrial and mass-consumption applications. Combines the authenticity of the artisan process with the practicality demanded by the modern market.

nuevosDerivados.descripcion: Line of new products derived from sugar cane and other Colombian agricultural crops, currently under development. Coming soon to the international market.

panelaFraccionadaX2.descripcion: Double-sized version of the round fractioned panela: twice the content in the same package, ideal for households and businesses with higher consumption. Same artisan quality, greater quantity.

panelaCuadrada.descripcion: Square-format panela block, designed for efficient storage and uniform presentation. Its regular shape facilitates packaging, stacking and international distribution.

panelaCuadradaX2.descripcion: Double format of the square panela: more content per unit to meet the demand of distributors and wholesalers. The same artisan quality from Santander, optimized for volume trade.

panelaPastilla.descripcion: Panela in tablet format: small, compact tablets of unrefined cane juice, perfect for precise dosing and modern packaging. Ideal for consumers seeking convenience without sacrificing authenticity.

panelaRedonda.descripcion: Round panela block — a classic, widely recognized presentation in Latin American and European markets. Its circular shape makes grating and dissolving easy while preserving all the minerals and characteristic flavor of the cane.

proceso.subtitulo: Every block of panela travels a path of tradition, care, and craftsmanship before reaching your market.

cultivo.desc: Grown in the mountains of Santander at over 1,200 m.a.s.l., the cane thrives without agrochemicals in mineral-rich soils.

cosecha.desc: Cutting is done by hand at the optimal maturity point, selecting only the finest quality cane stalks.

extraccion.desc: The cane is milled in the trapiche to extract fresh, dense juice loaded with natural nutrients.

coccion.desc: The juice is cooked in open pans over direct fire, removing impurities and concentrating sugars without losing minerals.

moldeo.desc: The hot molasses is beaten and poured into molds, taking its final form: blocks, broken pieces, or fine powder.

empaque.desc: Every batch undergoes quality control before being packaged to international standards and shipped to our partners worldwide.
